text: have you ever spent too much time out in
the sun and forgot to apply some lock
scold your arm after touching a hot pen
or spill coffee on yourself
accidentally the severity of burns are
categorized into first second and third
degrees for minor burns which is first
or second lower degree this is treatable
at home while others have to be treated
in a medical
facility directly after receiving a burn
place the affected area under cool water
for 10 to 15 minutes or until the pain
eases this is to stop the burn from
spreading to the surrounding
area remove items such as Rings or tight
jewelry from the affected area do this
before the swelling
starts apply a thin layer of aloe vera
lotion on the burnt area to help soothe
the pain and promote healing make sure
the affected area is kept clean and dry
to prevent infection
if the burn has an open wound clean and
dress the wound like how you would for a
small cut or
abration do not apply butter or ice on
the wound as it might set the affected
area up for frost bites or infections
this video is a guide for basic first
aid if you are unsure about what to do
visit your nearest medical facility
immediately
